prompt: High, wide, locked-off view down the misty straight. The long line of horses waits at the stalls in a single row, silks bright against the grass, a few heads bobbing. After a short pause every gate opens at once and the whole field moves off together, perfectly level, a single straight line of horses galloping up the wide green track toward the misty bend, nobody ahead and nobody behind. Spray rises from the wet turf. Sound: one crisp clang along the whole row, a rumble of many hooves, light rain, a distant cheer, no talking. Real-looking footage of an English racecourse on a grey, wet day. Thanks.
